issue_request: FHIR-47349 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-core Subscription clarification asking the payload-type paragraph to state that a server accepting a Subscription with modifications returns the accepted modified version to the client.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists subscription=Subscription, confirming the inspected notes file is in build scope. FHIR-I 2025-03-31 minutes include FHIR-47349 in a Persuasive Subscriptions block vote with a 17-0-0 motion. Source and community searches found no conflicting evidence or remaining old wording in the Subscription notes.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active source already conveys the requested semantics. The phrase "accepted and modified version" is equivalent to, and slightly clearer than, the Jira-requested "accepted modified version".
